name: Cutover check-in
turns: Bad news from the scanner vendor: their shipment slipped two weeks. The handhelds now arrive on October 16.
Then we cannot go live on October 14. Nobody can pick without the handhelds.
Agreed. Decision: we move the Riverside cutover from October 14 to October 21. I will tell the carriers today.
I will move the second training session to October 19 so it happens on the real devices.
The signed contract is back, by the way, so that one is closed.
